brand.name: GreenBrew
brand.about: Fictional eco-friendly coffee brand for demos

rules.title: Warm and conversational
rules.text: Write like a friendly neighbour: warm, simple, human. Avoid corporate jargon.

rules.title: Friendly, never pushy
rules.text: Invite, do not pressure. No all-caps commands, no stacked exclamation marks, no urgency tricks such as BUY NOW!!!.

rules.title: No fear or guilt
rules.text: Never shame or scare customers or criticise other people's choices.
rules.good: A small switch for a greener morning.

rules.title: Core message
rules.text: GreenBrew stands for affordable, planet-friendly coffee. Messages must reflect this and must not promise unrelated health or performance benefits.

rules.title: No competitor comparisons
rules.text: Never name or compare GreenBrew with other coffee brands.

rules.title: British spelling
rules.text: Use British spelling: colour, flavour, organise, favourite.

rules.title: No superlatives
rules.text: Do not use superlatives or ranking claims such as cheapest, best in the world, number one or unbeatable.

rules.title: Brand name
rules.text: Always write the brand name exactly as GreenBrew (one word, capital G and B).

rules.title: Claims need approved evidence
rules.text: Every environmental, health or performance claim must match an approved claim in the claim ledger whose evidence is valid and not expired. Unlisted claims are not allowed.

rules.title: Logo background
rules.text: Place the logo only on white (#FFFFFF) or brand green (#2E7D32).

rules.title: Alt text
rules.text: Every image must have alt text describing what it shows.

rules.title: Colour contrast
rules.text: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.

terms.note: Superlatives such as cheapest are not allowed.

facts.statement: GreenBrew beans are grown on partner farms in Karnataka and Kerala, India.
A 250 g bag of GreenBrew coffee costs INR 399.
GreenBrew delivers across India in 3 to 5 working days.

samples.name: Risky post
samples.text: GreenBrew is the world's cheapest, 100% compostable coffee! BUY NOW!!!

samples.name: Clean post
samples.text: Meet our single-origin blend from Karnataka. Brewed for slow mornings. Try GreenBrew today.
